steps.en: Install Certbot on the web server
steps.zh: 在 Web 服务器上安装 Certbot

steps.en: Run it against your web server
steps.zh: 对着你的 Web 服务器跑一次

steps.en: Generates the key locally, orders via ACME, proves domain control over HTTP-01
steps.zh: 本地生成私钥，走 ACME 下单，用 HTTP-01 证明域名控制权

steps.en: Saves the cert/key and rewrites the server config to serve HTTPS
steps.zh: 保存证书与私钥，改写服务器配置以提供 HTTPS

steps.en: A timer runs certbot renew, which replays each cert's saved config near expiry
steps.zh: 定时器周期执行 renew，按证书留存配置在临期时静默续期

value.en: Free, browser-trusted HTTPS that renews itself — no expiry incident, no hand-edited cert paths
value.zh: 免费、浏览器信任、会自己续期的 HTTPS——没有过期事故，也不用手改证书路径

sources: certbot.eff.org instructions (ws=nginx&os=snap, retrieved 2026-09-28): sudo snap install --classic certbot; sudo ln -s /snap/bin/certbot /usr/local/bin/certbot; sudo certbot --nginx; sudo certbot renew --dry-run

eff-certbot.readthedocs.io using.html (retrieved 2026-09-28): 'saving the certificate to /etc/letsencrypt/live/', 'certbot renew', check systemd timers/crontab for automated renewal, renewal threshold 'less than 1/3rd of its lifetime remains'
README.rst main @ 2026-09: Apache 2.4+/nginx 0.8.48+ support, ECDSA (default) and RSA keys, http->https redirect
